The bug has been fixed and verified.

### Summary of Fix
1. In [`UnsupportedDurationField.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/time_1_group_b_fix/src/main/java/org/joda/time/field/UnsupportedDurationField.java#L224-L230):
   - Removed the `if (durationField.isSupported()) return 1;` check in [`compareTo`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/time_1_group_b_fix/src/main/java/org/joda/time/field/UnsupportedDurationField.java#L226) so it consistently returns `0` as documented.
2. In [`Partial.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/time_1_group_b_fix/src/main/java/org/joda/time/Partial.java#L214-L230):
   - Added validation for unsupported duration fields (such as `era`). When an unsupported duration field appears after a supported field, an `IllegalArgumentException` is thrown indicating that the types array must be in order largest-smallest.
   - When consecutive unsupported fields appear, an `IllegalArgumentException` is thrown indicating duplicate unsupported types.
   - In the `compare == 0` check, verified `lastUnitField.equals(loopUnitField)` so unsupported fields are not incorrectly treated as equal-duration supported fields.

- Ran the original failing test `org.joda.time.TestPartial_Constructors#testConstructorEx7_TypeArray_intArray`, which now passes.
